literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-Apollinarius against Greeks and on religion and on truth. He-is Hierapolitan the author, of-the in Asia Hierapolis become bishop; he-flourished under Marcus Antoninus Verus king of-the Romans. Notable the man and with notable expression employing. Said of-him also other memoirs worth-mentioning to-be, which not-yet we came-upon.
source_text: Codex 14 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 4; closeout-4b transcription)
